☀️ Your money this morning, Thursday 12 November

🇺🇸 Overnight in New York: AI and chip stocks bounced back after strong results from cloud company CoreWeave. The Nasdaq rose 1.6%, the S&P 500 1.3% and the Dow 0.5%. Apple closed at a record high.

🇿🇦 The JSE Top 40 closed 1.1% lower on Wednesday.

💱 This morning the rand is flat at about R16.60 to the dollar. Brent oil is down 1.6% at about $91, and gold is down 0.3% at about $3,975.

What it means for you: cheaper oil helps the case for a petrol price cut in December. The rand is a little weaker than yesterday morning (R16.53).

Prices are 15-minute delayed (06:53). Education, not financial advice.
